test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT regarded as a capital expenditure?

options.text: The installation of a new coffee-making machine for ₹20,000.
The purchase of VCR and TV for the use in the club lounge for ₹55,000.
The purchase of snacks and food stuff for ₹52,000.
The building of an extension of the club dressing room for ₹75,000.

solution:
The correct answer is** The purchase of snacks and food stuff for ₹52,000.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **The purchase of snacks and food stuff for ₹52,000:**

 
 
• This is classified as a revenue expenditure, not a capital expenditure. Revenue expenditures are short-term expenses used for the day-to-day operation of a business, such as purchasing inventory or paying salaries.
 
• These expenses are fully deducted in the accounting period in which they are incurred, as they provide benefits only within that period.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The installation of a new coffee-making machine for ₹20,000:**

 
 
• This is a capital expenditure because it involves acquiring a long-term asset that will provide benefits to the business over multiple accounting periods.
 
 
 
• **The purchase of VCR and TV for the use in the club lounge for ₹55,000:**
 
 
• This is a capital expenditure as it involves purchasing equipment that will be used over several years, providing long-term benefits to the club.
 
 
 
• **The building of an extension of the club dressing room for ₹75,000:**
 
 
• This is also a capital expenditure, as it involves improving a fixed asset (the building) and extends its useful life, providing benefits over multiple periods.
